title: OK. "AI PONT" (Changhong, device ikebukuro), Android TV 11 (API 30), firmware RTO2.250804.001,
header:
OK. "AI PONT" (Changhong, device ikebukuro), Android TV 11 (API 30), firmware RTO2.250804.001,
1280x720 panel, about 0.9 GB RAM (MemTotal 929000 kB). Vendor layer Homwee (com.homwee.*), content
recognition from Anoki. Same platform family as examples/chiq-ai-pont.

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/ok-ai-pont-ikebukuro/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/ok-ai-pont-ikebukuro/debloat.txt
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Stock launcher: com.google.android.tvlauncher. Live TV: com.mediatek.wwtv.tvcenter.
Tested the same day on one set and through two reboots, not a multi-day soak. Every package stayed
disabled after both reboots. Then launcher/build-and-install.sh set com.gathin.tvhome as Home (checked with
mFocusedApp after Home and after a reboot) and tools/theme.sh pushed config.json (dock: Netflix, YouTube,
Prime Video, RaiPlay). Checked: D-pad across the dock, grid and top bar; Inputs lists HDMI 1, HDMI 2,
AV and Live TV, and Live TV opens tvcenter; a video plays (YouTube or Netflix) with AdGuard Private DNS on; the real
remote's Input, Settings, Netflix, YouTube and Prime Video buttons all still work without tvlauncher.
Only com.google.android.tvlauncher and com.android.tv.settings/.system.FallbackHome answer HOME, so
setupwraith is left alone (one saved Wi-Fi network belongs to it).
com.homwee.dmt.upgrade crashes at every start (NullPointerException in readProjectID), also with every
Homwee package and Anoki re-enabled, so it is the firmware, not this list.
Shipped disabled: com.cltv.fast (FAST channels), com.google.android.marvin.talkback.

KEEP: com.google.android.leanbacklauncher.partnercustomizer (see examples/chiq-ai-pont),
com.homwee.dmt.upgrade (firmware updates), com.homwee.synckey (remote keys), com.homwee.factory,
com.mediatek.* (Live TV, inputs, remote pairing, picture), com.mstar.android.tv.disclaimercustomization,
com.google.android.apps.nbu.smartconnect.tv (Google connectivity helper, left alone).
